items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: And Parker was in the band then and Luther West was in the band

ctx.x: And Parker was in the band then and Luther West was in the band--I'm trying to think who else--I believe Artis Paul was in the band then. We had a big band and several good outstanding musicians there, and
Carl White--did you ever know him, a bass player?
